The chatbot currently keeps tasks only in memory, so tasks disappear when it exits.

Save task-list changes to data/duke.txt and load saved tasks at startup.

Use Path.of("data", "duke.txt") to keep the relative file path OS-independent.

Deadline tasks store due values as unvalidated text.

Text values cannot validate calendar input or render due dates consistently.

Let's parse supported deadline input into java.time values and format it for display.

Use strict formatters so invalid calendar values are rejected while ISO-8601 values keep saved deadlines portable.

Correct the save file name, persist mark and delete operations, and isolate UI-test data between cases.

commitResults.messageBody:
Bro owns the task collection alongside command, storage, and UI logic, which mixes responsibilities in one class.

Move task ownership and basic collection operations into TaskList while keeping command behavior unchanged. Keep the named bro package consistent so the refactor remains buildable and easy to extend.

Bro mixes command tokenization, argument validation, and task-specific parsing with dispatch and application flow.

Move those input responsibilities into Parser and represent tokenized input with Command. Preserve the existing error messages and command behavior while giving the remaining refactoring steps a focused parsing boundary.

Bro still performs file I/O and understands the on-disk task format, which couples persistence to command handling.

Move loading, saving, serialization, and deserialization into Storage. Keep the file format and user-facing error messages unchanged so persistence remains compatible while the application gains a clear storage boundary.

Bro still owns console I/O and application lifecycle details, leaving its responsibilities spread across command processing and task operations.

Move console interaction into Ui and make Bro an instance-level coordinator of Parser, Storage, TaskList, and Ui. Keep the command loop and output text stable while completing the requested object-oriented separation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Java style: Organize classes into packages
commitResults.messageBody:
Move application classes into matching packages under src/main/java.

Keep Bro in bro and group command, storage, task, UI, and exception responsibilities in subpackages. Update imports and accessors to preserve the existing behavior across package boundaries.

Update tests and the UI test plan so nested package sources compile and the application launches as bro.Bro.

Add focused tests for command parsing, persistence, task state, event formatting, and UI output.\n\nTarget the highest-value non-trivial public behavior so the project maintains roughly 50% JUnit coverage and catches regressions in core workflows. Document the coverage target and require tests to be updated after each code change.

Configure the application and Shadow plugin to use Bro as the executable entry point and produce a fat duke.jar.\n\nDocument the build output, empty-folder execution workflow, relative task-data location, and GitHub release distribution so the generated binary remains outside version control.
